VehicleTwin native-safe substitution: the web VehicleTwin is a 40KB framer-motion + SVG car illustration (per-instance useId gradients/filters, ChargingUnderglow, lucide Lock/Unlock/Shield, Tooltip) with no React Native analogue. The native twin renders a paint-colored body panel (height scaled by size sm/md/lg) plus the same at-a-glance status chips the web SVG surfaced — Locked(green)/Unlocked(red), Sentry Mode(red), Charging(green underglow->green border + ⚡ chip).
